abstract: Maintains thermal energy recovery and circular economy performance metrics
system_message:
You are the Facility sustainability coordinator (SUST), responsible for maintaining thermal energy recovery and circular economy performance metrics across commercial solvent recovery and distillation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cooling water recirculation（WATER）
information_points.content:
SUST-WATER-XP4：Water treatment records for the evaporative cooling tower circuit at the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility reflect 4 cycles of cooling tower cycles of concentration.
SUST-WATER-O5M：Water treatment logs for the evaporative cooling tower circuit at the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant document 8 cycles of cooling tower cycles of concentration.
SUST-WATER-M8R：Water treatment monitoring for the evaporative cooling tower circuit at the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex demonstrates 6 cycles of cooling tower cycles of concentration.

information_points.title: Maintains thermal energy recovery and circular economy performance metrics（CIRC）
information_points.content:
SUST-CIRC-KQJ：For the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex, the waste heat recovery ratio measured across the condenser cooling and reboiler thermal loop is 75 %, reflecting the proportion of reboiler heat energy recaptured and reused in auxiliary processes.
SUST-CIRC-WW7：For the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant, the energy efficiency assessment of the condenser cooling and reboiler thermal loop records a waste heat recovery ratio of 45 % of reboiler heat energy recaptured and reused across auxiliary plant processes.
SUST-CIRC-VE4：For the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility, the energy efficiency assessment of the condenser cooling and reboiler thermal loop indicates a waste heat recovery ratio of 45 %, representing the share of reboiler heat energy recaptured and reused across auxiliary plant processes.
